WITH ref AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-97.371636 27.703648)', 4326)::geometry AS g
),
nearest AS (
  SELECT r.road_name,
         r.geometry::geometry AS geom,
         ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-97.371636 27.703648)', 4326)::geography) AS dist_m
  FROM roads r, ref
  WHERE r.highway = 'service'
    AND r.road_name IS NOT NULL
    AND ST_Dimension(r.geometry::geometry) = 1
    AND ST_NPoints(r.geometry::geometry) BETWEEN 2 AND 50
    AND r.geometry::geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-126, 24, -66, 50, 4326)
    AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-97.371636 27.703648)', 4326)::geography, 100000)
  ORDER BY r.geometry::geometry <-> ref.g
  LIMIT 1
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(n.geom)).geom AS seg FROM nearest n
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
         ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
         ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT e.seg_len_m,
         z1.v AS z1,
         z2.v AS z2
  FROM endpoints e
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p1) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p1)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z1 ON z1.v IS NOT NULL
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p2) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z2 ON z2.v IS NOT NULL
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT seg_len_m,
         CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT n.road_name,
       n.dist_m,
       DEGREES(ATAN(SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0))) AS slope_deg
FROM nearest n
CROSS JOIN slopes
WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY n.road_name, n.dist_m;

```sql
WITH nearest_service_road AS (
  SELECT
    r.id,
    r.geometry,
    ST_Distance(
      ST_SetSRID(ST_Point(-97.371636, 27.703648), 4326)::geography,
      r.geometry
    ) AS distance_meters
  FROM
    roads r
  WHERE
    r.highway = 'service'
  ORDER BY
    ST_Distance(
      ST_SetSRID(ST_Point(-97.371636, 27.703648), 4326)::geography,
      r.geometry
    )
  LIMIT 1
),
road_line AS (
  SELECT
    geometry
  FROM
    nearest_service_road
),
terrain_profile AS (
  SELECT
    ST_3DInterpolatePoints(
      r.rast,
      (SELECT geometry FROM road_line),
      'LINESTRING'
    ) AS elevation_profile
  FROM
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(
      r.rast,
      (SELECT geometry FROM road_line)
    )
),
slope_profile AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(
      r.rast,
      1,
      '32BF'
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(
      r.rast,
      (SELECT geometry FROM road_line)
    )
),
average_slope AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Union(slope_rast) AS slope_rast_union
  FROM
    slope_profile
),
final_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ST_3DInterpolatePoints(
      (SELECT slope_rast_union FROM average_slope),
      (SELECT geometry FROM road_line),
      'LINESTRING'
    ) AS slope_profile
)
SELECT
  (SELECT display_name FROM (VALUES ('University of Incarnate Word School of Professional Studies, Corpus Christi, TX')) AS t(display_name)) AS location_name,
  (SELECT distance_meters FROM nearest_service_road) AS nearest_road_distance_meters,
  ST_Avg(ST_Values(slope_profile)) AS average_slope_degrees
FROM
  final_stats;
```
